description: Canonical bytes, RS256 vectors and earliest-deadline vectors for GrantSnapshotV1 and OfflineLicensePermitV1. The signatures were made once with a throwaway fixture key whose private half is not kept anywhere; it is not a deployment key and proves nothing about a live licensing provider.

encoding.payload: UTF-8 JSON, members in the order shown, no whitespace, lowercase hyphenated GUIDs, UTC instants with six fractional digits

deadlines.name: authority-verification-plus-48h
deadlines.why: Nothing else is earlier than the upstream verification's 48 hours.

deadlines.name: licence-end
deadlines.why: The original grant's own trading deadline.

deadlines.name: stricter-current-head
deadlines.why: A newer operating head that ends sooner shortens the permit.

deadlines.name: more-generous-current-head
deadlines.why: A newer head that ends later never extends the original grant.

deadlines.name: lease-expiry
deadlines.why: The reserved invoice lease's own end.

deadlines.name: fiscal-year-end
deadlines.why: 1 April 00:00 IST, even for a lease recorded as ending later.

deadlines.name: lease-ends-with-fiscal-year
deadlines.why: A lease capped at the fiscal year end: the tie names the lease.

deadlines.name: stock-evidence-expiry
deadlines.why: Earliest retained lot evidence of the snapshot.

deadlines.name: complete-empty-snapshot
deadlines.why: No lots, so no stock-evidence cap; every other cap still applies.

deadlines.name: till-business-day-end
deadlines.why: Local midnight of the open till session's business day.

deadlines.name: freshness-tie-names-authority
deadlines.why: Verification, reservation and completion at one instant all end together; authority is named.

deadlines.name: renewed-snapshot-does-not-extend
deadlines.why: A snapshot completed 47 hours later still ends with the original verification.

deadlines.name: last-microsecond
deadlines.why: Issued one microsecond before the deadline.

deadlines.name: at-the-deadline
deadlines.why: The window is half-open: nothing is issued at the deadline.

deadlines.name: verification-after-reservation
deadlines.why: A verification stamped after the device reserved is not this grant's evidence.

deadlines.name: snapshot-before-reservation
deadlines.why: A snapshot completed before the lease was reserved.

deadlines.name: snapshot-after-issue
deadlines.why: A completion stamped in the future.
